## Common WHERE Filters

### 分区过滤

```sql
-- regional 时区分区（manual_tasks/hr 中使用）
WHERE regional_date = '${grassDate}'
  AND grass_region IN (${Asia_region})

-- local 时区分区（AB test workflow 中使用）
WHERE local_date = date('${grass_date}')
  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')
```

### 业务线 + 模块 + 对象过滤

```sql
-- 每日发现商品卡片
WHERE business_line = 'Homepage'
  AND module = 'Daily Discover'
  AND object = 'item card'

-- YMAL 商品推荐
WHERE business_line = 'Rcmd'
  AND module = 'User Scenario'
  AND object = 'you may also like'
  AND feature_detail = 'product-you_may_also_like-item'

-- 全局搜索商品
WHERE business_line = 'Search'
  AND module = 'Global Search'
  AND feature_detail LIKE '%-item'

-- 首页排除 Daily Discover 和 Flash Sale
WHERE business_line = 'Homepage'
  AND module NOT IN ('Daily Discover', 'Flash Sale')

-- 首页排除 Daily Discover, Flash Sale, Shopee Live, Shopee Video
WHERE (business_line = 'Homepage' AND module NOT IN ('Daily Discover','Flash Sale','Shopee Live','Shopee Video'))
   OR (source1_business_line = 'Homepage' AND source1_module NOT IN ('Daily Discover','Flash Sale','Shopee Live','Shopee Video'))
   OR (source2_business_line = 'Homepage' AND source2_module NOT IN ('Daily Discover','Flash Sale','Shopee Live','Shopee Video'))
```

### 来源归因过滤

```sql
-- YMAL 导直播
WHERE source1_object = 'you may also like'
  AND source1_feature_detail = 'product-you_may_also_like-livestream'

-- YMAL 导全局搜索
WHERE source1_object = 'you may also like'
  AND source1_feature_detail = 'product-you_may_also_like-search'

-- YMAL 导图片搜索
WHERE object = 'you may also like'
  AND feature_detail = 'product-you_may_also_like-image_search_item'

-- MPP 导全局搜索
WHERE source1_object = 'post purchase'
  AND source1_feature LIKE 'mpp_ymal%'
  AND source1_feature_detail = 'order_list-you_may_also_like-search'
```

### 特征组过滤

```sql
-- Flash Sales, not found atc, Others, Live Streaming, Video
WHERE feature_group IN ('Flash Sales', 'not found atc', 'Others', 'Live Streaming', 'Video')
   OR source1_feature_group = 'Live Streaming'
```

### JOIN on grass_region for cross-feature deduction

```sql
-- 从业务线总指标中扣除导流到其他 feature 的量
LEFT JOIN ymal_to_image_search b ON a.grass_region = b.grass_region
LEFT JOIN ymal_to_live c          ON a.grass_region = c.grass_region
LEFT JOIN ymal_to_global_search d ON a.grass_region = d.grass_region
LEFT JOIN mpp_to_global_search e  ON a.grass_region = e.grass_region
```

### Snippet 1: AB Test — Organic 指标提取 (Search/DD/YMAL)

-- DD & YMAL organic

  AND grass_region = upper('${region}')

### Snippet 3: 首页 feature 分解 (Homepage Features)

```sql
-- 首页 Daily Discover / Flash Sale / Homepage Features
SELECT
    CASE WHEN a.module = 'all' THEN 'Homepage Features'
         WHEN a.module = 'Daily Discover' THEN 'Daily Discover'
         WHEN a.module = 'Flash Sale' THEN 'Flash Sales'
    END AS feature,
    SUM(impr_cnt_1d)  AS imp_cnt_login_user,
    SUM(click_cnt_1d) AS click_cnt_login_user,
    SUM(order_1d)     AS order_cnt,
    SUM(gmv_usd_1d)   AS gmv_usd
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dws_business_line_sales_funnel_metrics_1d__reg_sensitive_live
WHERE regional_date = '${grassDate}'
  AND grass_region IN (${Asia_region})
  AND business_line = 'Homepage'
  AND module IN ('Daily Discover', 'all', 'Flash Sale')
  AND object = 'all'
GROUP BY feature, grass_region, grass_date;
```

### Snippet 4: 多来源归因 + 排除逻辑 (Homepage Others)

```sql
-- Other HP: 排除 Daily Discover 和 Flash Sale
SELECT 'Other HP' AS feature,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN impr_cnt_1d > 0 THEN user_id END) AS imp_uu,
    SUM(order_1d)   AS order_cnt,
    SUM(gmv_usd_1d) AS gmv_usd
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dws_business_line_sales_funnel_metrics_1d__reg_sensitive_live
WHERE regional_date = '${grassDate}'
  AND grass_region IN (${Asia_region})
  AND ((business_line = 'Homepage' AND module NOT IN ('Daily Discover','Flash Sale'))
    OR (source1_business_line = 'Homepage' AND source1_module NOT IN ('Daily Discover','Flash Sale'))
    OR (source2_business_line = 'Homepage' AND source2_module NOT IN ('Daily Discover','Flash Sale')))
GROUP BY grass_region, regional_date;
```

### Snippet 5: feature_detail + source1 归因组合 (导流分析)

```sql
-- YMAL 导 global search
SELECT regional_date AS grass_date, grass_region,
    SUM(order_1d)      AS order_cnt,
    SUM(gmv_usd_1d)    AS gmv_usd
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dws_business_line_sales_funnel_metrics_1d__reg_sensitive_live
WHERE regional_date = '${grassDate}'
  AND grass_region IN (${Asia_region})
  AND source1_object = 'you may also like'
  AND source1_feature_detail = 'product-you_may_also_like-search'
GROUP BY regional_date, grass_region;
```

### Snippet 6: 私域 + 其他用户场景 (Rcmd private domain & other US)

```sql
SELECT
    CASE WHEN feature_detail = 'mpp_ymal%' THEN 'My Purchase Page'
         WHEN feature_detail LIKE 'me_buy_again%' THEN 'Buy Again (Me Page)'
         WHEN feature_detail LIKE 'osp_ymal%' THEN 'Order Successful Recommendation'
         ELSE 'Rcmd Others'
    END AS feature,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN item_impr_cnt_1d > 0 THEN user_id END) AS imp_uu,
    SUM(item_impr_cnt_1d)  AS imp_cnt,
    SUM(item_click_cnt_1d) AS click_cnt,
    SUM(order_1d)          AS order_cnt,
    SUM(gmv_usd_1d)        AS gmv_usd
FROM traffic_omni_oa.dws_business_line_sales_funnel_metrics_1d__reg_sensitive_live
WHERE regional_date = '${grassDate}'
  AND grass_region IN (${Asia_region})
  AND (business_line = 'Rcmd' OR source1_business_line = 'Rcmd' OR source2_business_line = 'Rcmd')
  AND ((module = 'Private Domin')
    OR (module = 'User Scenario' AND object IN ('post purchase','us others'))
    OR (source1_module = 'User Scenario' AND source1_object IN ('post purchase','us others'))
    OR (source2_module = 'User Scenario' AND source2_object IN ('post purchase','us others')))
GROUP BY feature, grass_region, regional_date;
```

### Snippet 7: 扣除导流量的净指标计算

```sql
-- YMAL 净订单 = 总订单 - 导 image_search - 导 live - 导 global_search
SELECT feature,
    CASE WHEN feature = 'You May Also Like'
         THEN (a.order_cnt - COALESCE(b.order_cnt,0) - COALESCE(c.order_cnt,0) - COALESCE(d.order_cnt,0))
         ELSE a.order_cnt
    END AS order_cnt_net,
    CASE WHEN feature = 'You May Also Like'
         THEN (a.gmv_usd - COALESCE(b.gmv_usd,0) - COALESCE(c.gmv_usd,0) - COALESCE(d.gmv_usd,0))
         ELSE a.gmv_usd
    END AS gmv_usd_net
FROM feature_totals a
LEFT JOIN ymal_to_image_search b  ON a.grass_region = b.grass_region
LEFT JOIN ymal_to_live c          ON a.grass_region = c.grass_region
LEFT JOIN ymal_to_global_search d ON a.grass_region = d.grass_region;
```

### 用户级去重指标（UV）

| Derived Metric | Formula |
|---------------|---------|
| imp_uu | `COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN impr_cnt_1d > 0 THEN user_id END)` |
| imp_uu_org | `COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN impr_organic_cnt_1d > 0 THEN user_id END)` |

### 导流净指标

| Derived Metric | Formula |
|---------------|---------|
| YMAL 净订单 | `order_cnt - SUM(ymal_to_image_search + ymal_to_live + ymal_to_global_search)` |
| MPP 净订单 | `order_cnt - SUM(mpp_to_global_search)` |
| Rcmd Features 净订单 | `order_cnt - SUM(all ymal redirects + all mpp redirects)` |
